messages:
sam: Noticing a p95-only blip on /v1/chat/generate (prod - eu-central) at ~10:14 UTC. p50 unchanged.

Tess: I see it on the console. It looks concentrated on requests routed to the experimental fallback path (weight=4%).

leo: Is the panel pulling the raw-sample stream or the historical tdigest rollup for that slice? We recently toggled rollup fallback behavior.

sam: The endpoint-percentile panel is supposed to prefer raw samples for last 1h, but fallback to rollups when samplecount < 100. This cohort had ~1.1k samples, so shouldn't fallback.

maya: I ran a quick split and the uplift correlates with requests that have >2k tokens and header X-Route: fallback-vec. Also an uptick in kvcache_miss_rate for that variant.

sam: That points at backend work (kvcache/model variant) rather than ingress retries. Can you join traces to compare ingress_latency vs model_processing_latency?

maya: Did a join for 10:12-10:18 UTC. Most traces show model_processing_latency spiking; ingress close to normal. Top trace ids: trace-abc1, trace-def2, trace-ghi3.

leo: Another vector: tdigest can produce different quantiles if ingestion weights changed due to route-weight reshuffle yesterday. Even with 1k samples the rollup p95 can shift if token counts per sample changed.

Tess: Good point. Also remember client-side retry rollback earlier today. Retries can create artificial tail if panels include ingress (client -> gateway) durations. Which metric does our p95 panel show?

sam: It's the endpoint-level latency emitted by the gateway (includes queue + model). We'll need to check whether the panel is showing "endpoint.gateway.latency.p95.raw" or "endpoint.gateway.latency.p95.rollup".

maya: I queried raw samples for the minute of the spike: median ~220ms, p95 ~430ms, p99 ~1.05s. tdigest-derived p95 for that minute was ~560ms.

leo: So raw vs tdigest disagree by ~130ms. That indicates rollup weighting effect. For action: (1) add fallback_variant tag to metric emitter so we can slice quickly, (2) add a raw/rollup toggle to percentile panels, (3) consider gating the canary: pause if p95 > 300ms sustained 5m.

sam: I'll file a small PR to emit fallback_variant and adjust gating rule.

Tess: I'll open a console UX ticket for the raw/rollup toggle + a tooltip explaining tdigest caveats (weighting, bucket boundaries).

maya: Pushed a small test harness: curl to canary host with X-Route: fallback-vec and a 2.5k token prompt. Observed p95 ~450ms, occasional 1s+. Reproduces the midtail.

ingest-bot: metric-tags release v1.2 rolled to canary at 10:22 UTC (deploy-7132).

sam: After deploy p95 for the marked variant dropped to baseline within two minutes. We can close but keep annotation on the timeframe and doc note. :thumbsup:

Tess: Adding ops checklist item: when p95-only spikes appear, verify panel derivation (raw vs rollup), check samplecount and tdigest ingestion windows, and compare ingress vs model processing latencies.

leo: Also proposing an API addition: expose both raw-sample and rollup-derived percentiles in metric API so consumers can choose explicitly.

maya: Created console issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/1422 with traces, curl script, and queries.

sam: Great triage. Thanks all.
